prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was cleaning out my email and found that old shipping update—tracking number YT9876543210. Funny how I obsessed over it back then.
That whole spring 2025 trip started with me bouncing from Beijing to Shanghai, and I remember everyone debating trains versus flying like it was a life decision.
After that we swung down to Guangzhou for a bit—honestly I mostly remember the food and how humid it was.
Shanghai was the sightseeing part of the trip for me; I kept a little list of attractions I’d heard about from friends.
My friend Chen Ming had already booked his train—G3 on 2025-04-02, and he was all smug about getting First Class.
And in Guangzhou, Zhao Min stayed at The Ritz-Carlton Guangzhou—check-in was 2025-03-24 for 5 nights, which sounded way fancier than my setup.
Oh, and Li Na’s group did Yu Garden on 2025-03-27, afternoon slot—she said they grabbed 3 tickets and it was packed but worth it.
